{{Infobox auto}}

'''Honey ginger tea''' is the simple preparation of [[Honey|honey]]. It heals {{Value|Honey Ginger Tea|heals}}, grants {{EffectLink|Speed}} for {{Value|Honey Ginger Tea|duration|effect=Speed}} and removes harmful effects.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/honey_ginger_tea.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A honey bottle heats into honey ginger tea in an [[oven]] in {{Value|Honey Ginger Tea|cook_time|station=Oven}} or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Honey Ginger Tea|cook_time|station=Kindling}}.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Drinking honey ginger tea takes {{Value|Honey Ginger Tea|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Honey Ginger Tea|heals}}, gives Speed {{Value|Honey Ginger Tea|level|effect=Speed}} (+20% speed) for {{Value|Honey Ginger Tea|duration|effect=Speed|format=clock}} and removes the same maleffects as [[bread]]. It gives the glass bottle back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]], buying 3 at a time.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_37.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
